title: Add the WCAG 2.2 rules bee-design lacks, ported from ui-ux-pro-max
action: Write packages/bee/design/bee-design/additions/wcag-2-2.md with six rules (focus not obscured, drag alternative, accessible authentication, auto-rotation pause, scrim contrast on the real background, error summary with focus and field links) plus an MIT attribution line, and add one row to the More taste table in packages/bee/design/bee-design/SKILL.md that links it. The file lives outside references/ because scripts/sync-design-os.sh deletes and re-copies references/ on every sync.
